name: CDC Vouchers Scheme

scam_info.sample: The SMS is identifiable by the sender named “Gov.sg”. The voucher link should also start with the prefix https://voucher.redeem.gov.sg . Do not trust voucher links starting with other prefixes.
scam_info.notes: GENUINE identifiers (official): claim only via go.gov.sg/cdcv (Singpass); voucher SMS from sender gov.sg; voucher links start https://voucher.redeem.gov.sg; report suspicious messages to PA 6225 5322 or police i-witness / 1800 255 0000. 'Gov.sg ... will never send SMSes requiring your personal or banking details.' FAQ last updated 1 October 2026. vouchers.cdc.gov.sg sitemap (62 URLs, lastmod) has no scam page.

scam_info.sample: 1: Visit go.gov.sg/cdcv ... 3: Receive your CDC Voucher link by SMS from “gov.sg”

notes: Most-impersonated voucher brand: SPF brand tag 'CDC Vouchers' (4 advisories; SPF sample scam hosts, not visited: ptvs-...herokuapp.com, ...koyeb.app, ...up.railway.app). redeem.gov.sg (RedeemSG, OGP platform) is official per FAQ (a). Any voucher link not starting https://voucher.redeem.gov.sg is fake per the scheme's own rule -> strong pipeline rule. The scheme itself publishes no fake-site list.
